settings.headline: How to order equipment
settings.subtitle: Most equipment needs a prescription and some paperwork before insurance will pay. We take care of most of it. You will never be asked to pay on this website.

settings.headline: Four steps to equipment at home
settings.subtitle: Most people have their equipment within one or two business days of a complete order.

steps.title: Get an order from your doctor
steps.body: Ask your doctor or discharge planner to send us an order, or call us and we will request it for you.

steps.title: We verify your benefits
steps.body: We check your plan, request any prior authorization and call you with your cost.

steps.title: Delivery and setup
steps.body: We bring the equipment, set it up, and train you and your caregivers until you are comfortable.

steps.title: Ongoing support
steps.body: We handle resupply, repairs and rental pickups. Call any time you need us.

settings.headline: What a complete order includes
settings.body: Missing details are the most common reason an order is delayed. If anything is missing, we contact your doctor's office directly.

items.text: Your name, date of birth and insurance details
The equipment, accessories and how long you need it
Your diagnosis and why the equipment is needed at home
Notes from a visit in the last six months
Your doctor's signature and the date

settings.aside_body: Fax orders and visit notes to (800) 555-0139, or send them electronically. Our intake team reviews every order the same business day and calls your office if anything is missing.

settings.headline: Plans we work with
settings.body: We bill your plan directly. If your plan does not cover an item, we will tell you the self-pay price before you decide.

settings.headline: Ready to order?
settings.body: Call the order desk and have your insurance card ready. We will take it from there.
